title: INDIA Bloc Marches to Election Commission Over CEC Controversy, Alleges Vote Theft
detail: The INDIA bloc opposition alliance announced a protest march to the Election Commission of India (ECI) headquarters in New Delhi over the Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar controversy, alleging 'vote theft' by the ruling establishment. Security was heightened around the ECI building ahead of the demonstration.

media.caption: INDIA bloc opposition marches to Election Commission headquarters over CEC Gyanesh Kumar controversy

title: J&K CM Omar Abdullah Urges Patience as Supreme Court Addresses Mass Voter Roll Deletions
detail: Jammu & Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah stated India must wait to see how far the Supreme Court goes in rectifying mass voter roll deletions, signalling caution from the ruling bloc as legal proceedings advance against the controversial electoral-roll revision.

media.caption: J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah speaks on voter roll deletions and Supreme Court proceedings

title: Indian Opposition Leaders Briefly Arrested During Protest Against Chief Election Commissioner
detail: Opposition leaders from the INDIA bloc were briefly arrested during a protest targeting the Chief Election Commissioner, escalating the alliance's confrontation with election authorities over the voter-rolls controversy and demands for CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation.

media.caption: Indian opposition leaders briefly arrested during protest against Chief Election Commissioner
